title: Add filter toggle to TasksApp
description: Add a keyboard shortcut 'f' to cycle through task filters in TasksApp. Filters: All → Incomplete → Complete → Blocked → All. Show current filter in the header.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing 'f' cycles through All, Incomplete, Complete, Blocked filters
Current filter label shown in the header
Task list updates to show only matching tasks when filter is active
Filter cycles back to All after Blocked

steps.details: const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'incomplete' | 'complete' | 'blocked'>('all'). Add to useInput: if (input === 'f') { setFilter(f => { const filters = ['all','incomplete','complete','blocked'] as const; return filters[(filters.indexOf(f)+1) % 4] }) }

const filteredTasks = tasks.filter(t => { if (filter === 'all') return true; if (filter === 'incomplete') return !t.passes; if (filter === 'complete') return t.passes; if (filter === 'blocked') return !!t.blockedReason; return true })
Add to header: <Text>Filter: <Text color='cyan'>{filter.toUpperCase()}</Text> (press f to cycle)</Text>
